svg.aria-label: Research: green urea-imprinted PANi@CaO nanocomposite biosensors
svg.title: Research: green urea-imprinted PANi@CaO nanocomposite biosensors
svg.text: CaO nanoparticles grown from Syzygium cumini extract,
wrapped in a molecularly imprinted polyaniline film —
a low-cost electrochemical receptor for urea.
